description: This file contains Go test functions for the package synchronization module within the server component of the control plane. It tests the functionality of syncing packages from a registry, verifying correct storage of package data, and ensuring existing entries are not duplicated.

methods.name: TestSyncPackagesFromRegistryStoresMissingPackages
methods.description: Tests that missing packages are correctly stored during synchronization from the registry.

methods.name: TestSyncPackagesSkipsExistingEntries
methods.description: Tests that existing package entries are not duplicated during sync.
